title: Seeds 2 and 3 for the label-free kernel-drive C:swim-divide setting (chi 5, mu 1.0, kd 0.08): labkit L rim/core 1.58 and 1.57 (MEMBRANE-LIKE), 228 and 220 persistent splits (gen 6-7), 107-112 movers; ringtrack seed 2: ring >= 1.5 in 94.9% of cell-frames, 46 ringed swimmers >= 3 BL, one swim-ring-divide lineage (#455, 5.6 BL)
summary: Same world and WORLD_P as 20261026T0227-c29-kernel-ring-screen, on two new seeds. labkit (256^2, t=10000): seed 2, L rim/core 1.58, 943/1308 individually membrane-like, 228 persistent splits, generation 6, 105 merges, 112 tracks >= 1 BL, max 3.8 BL; seed 3, 1.57, 920/1275, 220, generation 7, 117 merges, 107 tracks, max 4.3 BL. ringtrack on seed 2 to t=20000: contour ring >= 1.5 in 94.9% of 7320 scored cell-frames (median 1.67), 68 persistent splits, generation 3, 19 merges, 48 tracks >= 3 BL (46 ringed), and one lineage that swims, keeps its ring and divides: #455, born by a split at t=3160, swims 5.63 BL with the ring in all scored frames and splits at t~6160. So the claim's numbers hold on 4 seeds. The same limit applies: motion and division happen while the cells colonize, before they jam.
